messages.body: DIRECTIVE 67903 NOTED: noted 7 ticket ref(s): BEB-2127, BEB-9271, BEB-6849, BEB-9202, BEB-9278, BEB-9281, BEB-2124 — NO lane state changed. The bridge never requeues (BEB-9174); a parked/held lane is a decision. To arm one deliberately: POST /dispatch/requeue {ticket} (actor+reason recorded).

CURRENT ORDER, replacing everything from last night. Read this instead of re-reading the thread — a lot of it was me correcting myself in a room nobody was in.

DONE AND CLOSED, do not redo: the 343 scripts are held three ways; the poller is live; role grants are held per m67832 (name and budget only, permissions go to the permission service, the filter stays a shape check); re-invites deferred, no mail in the critical path; Ory runs on box.abilifi.net and identity.bebond.net is not touched until the window closes.

DEAD NAMES, stop using them: the login page is not Gorky and never was — that was my error. Gorky is the request end of the declaration factory: a person asks, a declaration gets authored for a site against a real API, the shaper accepts or refuses by name, the ability runs. Nothing that only reads gets built.

ORDER NOW:
1. GRAPH DOOR. X-Org retired for Hydra callers, Keto per call. It blocks everything above it.
2. LOCK /sql AND /keto by source at Caddy to Cloudflare ranges. A database on the open internet behind one shared string is the worst exposure we have and it is a config change. Do not let it slip behind the graph door again.
3. THE SCOPED RUN from m67868 — which doors, as whom, what real work, what you make, where it refuses, and every missing hop named with its cost. Written down so I can read it and know whether it passed.

NEW SINCE YOU WOKE, and it is a P0 the loop cannot self-heal: see m67903. The dispatcher's effective cap resolves to 1 while get_state advertises 20, and 992 of 993 queued tickets are excluded on CONCURRENCY_CAP alone. Worse, the one slot goes to a weight-3 ticket while six weight-10 tickets are excluded — the cap runs before goal ordering. Ordering by goal weight is the rule. Answer with the file and line for each.

AND ONE PRODUCT TICKET IS NOW BUILDABLE: BEB-2124 ROCKETNET EXIT, bound to bebondnet/bebond-mcp, 20 client sites off RocketNet. It is blocked on one vaulted RocketNet credential (BEB-2126) and on nothing else

m67894 #3 GRAPH DOOR DONE — X-Org is no longer an authority for anyone who authenticates as themselves. abilifi-graph version 9af1a51d (commit df6675e90): a Hydra token is verified at the door against the box JWKS (RS256, aud must say "graph"), the subject's ORGS come from Keto (Org:<org>#members @ sub), X-Org may only SELECT among those memberships, and every tool call asks Keto Door:graph#read (read tools) or #write (mutating) before it runs; the touches ledger and written_by carry hydra:<sub>. PROOF, real calls from outside just now: (1) operator client, aud graph → search returns the node; touches row caller hydra:b8d3c599…, verb search, ok. (2) same token + X-Org: wpapps → 403 {"code":"org_not_yours","error":"… is not a member of 'wpapps' (Keto Org:wpapps#members)","orgs":["alexwiki","abilifi"]}. (3) token minted with aud vault at the graph door → 401 {"code":"hydra_refused","error":"aud [\"vault\"] does not name this door (graph)"}. (4) register (mutating) with the operator token → node written after Door:graph#write allowed; touches row hydra:b8d3c599…, registered, ok. (5) a fresh Hydra client with no tuples → 403 {"code":"unscoped_refused","error":"… is a member of no org … unscoped calls are refused"} (client deleted after). (6) bb_ path unchanged → 200 (dual-accept window). Tuples added: Door:graph read+write @ Role:operator#members; Org:abilifi members+owners for the operator client and Alex's identity (the graph's rows live under org abilifi; alexwiki is the operator org — both memberships, X-Org selects). Two of five doors read Ory: vault, graph. Remaining: shaper bearer (forwards to graph — inherits this), registry authOrg, abilifi-auth (hard-deny zone → ticket), sqld bearer (box-local; the poller and the store callers become Hydra clients). NOW: #4 the Caddy source lock on /sql and /keto.
